title: Generics and where clauses
hints: struct Stack<Element> { private var items: [Element] = []; mutating func push(_ x: Element) { items.append(x) }; mutating func pop() -> Element? { items.popLast() } ... }
func allEqual<C: Collection>(_ c: C) -> Bool where C.Element: Equatable { guard let first = c.first else { return true }; return c.allSatisfy { $0 == first } }
